0022600193.text: The Golden State Warriors host the Orlando Magic in the Warriors' 10th game of the 2026-27 season, arriving at 6-3 with a six-game winning streak, a 4-1 home record, and a second-place spot in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, in the 8th spot in the West. The Magic are 2-6 and 12th in the East, have lost three straight, and are 0-4 at home, and the teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Warriors winning the most recent meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Draymond Green (elbow inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf), and Gui Santos (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Orlando is missing Desmond Bane (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain).
